source_message.text:
Hi Shashank,

Sorry this took a little longer than expected. I didn't want to rush it because I wanted to make sure both the visuals and the voiceover came together in a way that feels engaging, natural, and scroll-stopping while staying true to the reference style you shared.

I also found that trying to fit everything into exactly 10 seconds made the story feel rushed. To give the emotions, product reveal, and voiceover enough room to breathe, I extended it slightly to 14 seconds. I believe this creates a much stronger and more natural viewing experience while maintaining the impact of a short-form ad.

I've attached the first draft for your review. I'd really appreciate your feedback, and if there are any changes you'd like to see, I'm more than happy to refine them.

I'm fully committed to ensuring you're completely satisfied with the final production and achieving the outcome you envision.
